programmes.d: Irma demands a refund for the party bus she rented from LaToya, stating it wasn't decorated properly.
Trudy is suing bar owner Jefferey for damages because she claims a drunk patron plowed into her parked car.
Kentra is here for a paternity test after the man who signed her birth certificate has been in and out of her life.
Andrew is accusing his ex boss of assault and demands retribution for his back pain after the attack.
Jane claims her ex-husband of 25 years owes her over $3,000 for their son's wedding.
Wilda is suing her neighbor for the cost of stolen speakers and $3,000 for harassment.
Jill is suing Laura after failing to repay a loan, but Laura says it was a gift.
Bruce says he thought he purchased a real taxidermy sail fish but says Michael fooled him into buying a plastic toy.
Mirtha is suing her ex-husband for stealing her car and leaving her to pay the bills after he up and left.
Chanel is suing her ex for a birthday gift and emotional distress after finding out he's been texting other women.
Sherrita thinks her Aunt Crystal spends all her money on clothes so she's suing her for car payments and car repairs.
Prestonie sues his mother for assault and hotel bills and claims she admitted to hating him.
Donna says the defendants stored their old beat up RV on her property and they owe her money.
Liatwanne petitions the court for rehab for her son, saying he's an addict who started using drugs as a teen.
Daniyal is suing her landlord for shutting off her electricity, cutting the gas, and evicting her without notice.
Brian is suing Robert after he installed a faulty DVD player in Brian's car that hasn't worked right since day 1.
Derek is suing for breach of contract after claiming the female dancers he ordered were on their phones.
